card.name: Endings of German and Slavic surnames
card.fires_on: The final piece of a long surname split into parts, such as -ner, -ke, -ky or -ema. It appears mostly in author names in citations and bylines.

modes.label: Surname endings in citations
modes.description: The closing piece of a German-style surname in a reference list or in-text citation.
modes.example: They comment on a few older papers: Buett<<ner>> and Kern (1965)

modes.label: Surname endings in bylines
modes.description: The closing piece of a Slavic or Dutch surname in a byline or credit line.
modes.example: Roger Beuk<<ema>> shares news from Lansing that impacts sportsmen
